Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de componente pentru industria aviatică și aerospațială și Fabricația de produse pentru apărare și domeniul spațial
Location: Bucharest, Romania
 About the Role:
 We are looking for a Fullstack Developer – ECO Application (React and JAVA)
 The ECO application is an internal Thales tool used for environmental risk assessment and the generation of regulatory documentation. It is developed by TGS/TCE and deployed on-premise within Thales entities.
In this role, you will ensure the operational maintenance, enhancement, and performance optimization of the ECO application supporting both ongoing delivery and production stability for a business-critical platform.
 Why Join?
 Work on an internal, high-impact application supporting regulatory documentation and environmental risk processes contributing to continuous improvement in an Agile delivery environment.
 Key Responsibilities:
Analyze, troubleshoot, and fix application defects, incidents, and operational issues
Develop new features and enhancements based on priorities from the Business Owner and Product Owner
Optimize and refactor code to improve performance, reliability, and maintainability
Participate in technical design, development, testing, and validation activities
Prepare deployment documentation and release instructions for corrective patches
Support deployment and production rollouts when required
Contribute to Agile/Kanban ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives
 Technical Skills:
Frontend (mandatory): HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ReactJS (nice to have)
Backend (core): Java, ORM, SOAP, REST, SQL, PL/pgSQL, PostgreSQL, Spring Boot (nice to have)
Operating System: Linux Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
Methodology: Agile / Kanban
 Candidate Profile:
Experienced Full Stack Developer with Java expertise
Solid database knowledge and experience maintaining business-critical applications
Strong ability to understand and analyze functional requirements and constraints
Demonstrated ability to work independently with the expected autonomy for the role
